note: parties[CLASS][n-1] is party number n (wTrainerNo; map objects use "OPP_CLASS, n"). location is the comment above the party in data/trainers/parties.asm. Party format: sharedLevel (first byte = level of every mon) or perMonLevel (first byte $FF, then level/species pairs). moves = WriteMonMoves default moveset for that level after specialMoves are applied (slot 3 = third move). stats = CalcStat with the fixed trainer DVs (Atk 9 Def 8 Spd 8 Spc 8 -> HP DV 8) and 0 stat exp. moneyReward = baseMoney x level of the LAST party mon (wCurEnemyLevel after ReadTrainer). Battles started by scripts (rival, some gym leaders, Giovanni, E4) pick the class/party in code: see trainer_classes[].scriptBattles.

aiMoveChoiceLayers.1: AIMoveChoiceModification1: if the player's mon already has a status, add 5 to every move with power 0 whose effect is in StatusAilmentMoveEffects (EFFECT_01, SLEEP_EFFECT, POISON_EFFECT, PARALYZE_EFFECT) - i.e. strongly discourage redundant status moves.
aiMoveChoiceLayers.2: AIMoveChoiceModification2: only when wAILayer2Encouragement == 1 (it is incremented each time the enemy executes a move and reset to 0 when a new enemy mon is sent out, so this is the 2nd turn of that mon): subtract 1 from every move whose effect is in [ATTACK_UP1_EFFECT, BIDE_EFFECT) or [ATTACK_UP2_EFFECT, POISON_EFFECT) - see data/battle/trainer_ai.json layer2PreferredEffects (includes the oddballs PAY_DAY_EFFECT and SWIFT_EFFECT; not Mist/Focus Energy).
aiMoveChoiceLayers.3: AIMoveChoiceModification3: for each move use AIGetTypeEffectiveness (the FIRST matching TypeEffects row only, starting from the bugged default $10): super effective -> subtract 1; not very effective / no effect -> add 1, but only if the enemy has another move that is damaging and of a different type, or Super Fang / special damage / Fly.
aiMoveChoiceLayers.selection: AIEnemyTrainerChooseMoves starts every move slot at 10 (a disabled move at 80), applies the class's layers in order, then keeps only the slots with the minimum score; SelectEnemyMove then picks among the kept slots with the usual 25/25/25/25% roll (rerolling empty/disabled slots). Wild mons skip the layers.
